activities.description: Locate, compare, synthesize, or generate research questions without upgrading evidence status.
Evaluate observations against candidate explanations; does not itself confer clinical or professional authority.
Develop or compare designs, architectures, mechanisms, or implementation choices.
Support a decision while preserving uncertainty, alternatives, constraints, and domain-specific authority requirements.
Explain or teach material without silently converting educational context into professional advice.
Reconstruct or assess evidence while keeping observation, inference, provenance, and conclusion distinct.
Interpret past events and sources with chronology and source-status controls.
Estimate future states while distinguishing model output, scenario, forecast, and observed outcome.
Assess what ought to be done while separating normative premises from empirical claims.
Generate fictional, artistic, satirical, hypothetical, or otherwise non-literal material with explicit register labelling.
